propos: Every component delivered at stage 0a, in all its variants and states.
etats-communs: Shared states: rest · pressed (fond-2 background) · focus (3 px ring, 2 px from the edge) · disabled (grey text on pale grey, never transparency) · loading (spinning arc, or skeleton). Every component is shown in the light theme; the dark theme applies the tokens of table 1.
interactif: Pressed and focus cannot be frozen on a board: press a control to see the first, tab through the section to see the second.
absents-propos: The mock-up also draws a session row, a document row, an activity row, a message bubble, a source quotation, a notification card and an avatar with its role badge. None of them ships at stage 0a: they arrive with the screen that uses them. Drawing them by hand would make the board lie, and a board that lies is worse than none.
